mentions.h: MATCH v. LONDON ATHLETIC CLUB. 5th MAY, 1934.

mentions.note: leader, Harry Wright Shield Competition, Long Jump 87.58%
won Police Championship Long Jump at Glasgow; 4th, "Harry Wright" Shield, Long Jump 20ft. 4½in., 87.58%
an old Belgrave member; won the Javelin for the South and 3rd in the Long Jump, third match
helped run field events at meetings

share.d: Bill Fleming in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1934–1945: 6 mentions in 4 issues and 4 race results.
